name: Sale a Devolver
storyline:
Set in a country choked by endless red tape, Sale a Devolver follows an everyday tax consultant working at a shady neighborhood agency under the iron fist of Don Anselmo. Your daily routine revolves around processing surreal tax returns under the constantly shifting, absurd regulations of the Official Gazette of Absurdity.

As cases become more complex, you must navigate high-stakes moral dilemmas: stick strictly to the law and risk missing your daily quota, or accept undeclared cash under the table to boost your income while raising the suspicion of the Tax Agency. Balancing your physical and mental exhaustion is essential—returning home to your loft to pet your dog Yeiko is your only refuge.

Ultimately, every signed document, stamped form, and questionable deduction builds toward a high-stakes tax audit. Depending on your choices, you will either remain a struggling clerk trapped in administrative limbo, escape with a hidden fortune, or face severe legal consequences.
summary: Sale a Devolver is a satirical management and bureaucracy simulator where players process tax returns under absurd, ever-changing regulations. Gameplay combines reading daily tax laws, managing undeclared income, meeting work quotas, and keeping stress levels under control.
